## Recommended Italian Restaurants in Downtown Chicago

### 1. **Ciccio Mio** (River North)
- **Address:** 226 W Kinzie St, Chicago, IL 60654
- **Style:** Intimate, old-school Italian with house-made gnocchi and traditional favorites
- **Reservations:** Released **21 days in advance** via their website
- **Book at:** https://www.cicciomio.com/

### 2. **RPM Italian** (River North)
- **Address:** 52 W Illinois St, Chicago, IL 60654
- **Style:** Upscale, celebrity-backed modern Italian with truffle garganelli
- **Reservations:** Book through their website or OpenTable
- **Note:** Very popular on Fridays; book well ahead

### 3. **Alla Vita** (West Loop)
- **Address:** 564 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60661
- **Style:** Michelin-recognized coastal Italian with open kitchen
- **Reservations:** Recommended for all party sizes
- **Book at:** https://www.allavitachicago.com/reservations

### 4. **Quartino Ristorante & Wine Bar** (River North)
- **Address:** 626 N State St, Chicago, IL 60654
- **Style:** Italian small plates (tapas-style), wood-fired pizzas, energetic atmosphere
- **Reservations:** Fill quickly on Fridays

### 5. **Il Porcellino** (River North)
- **Address:** 59 W Hubbard St, Chicago, IL 60654
- **Style:** Tuscan farmhouse-inspired with housemade salumi and pasta
- **Reservations:** Vanish weeks ahead for Friday nights

### 6. **Labriola** (Downtown)
- **Address:** Downtown Chicago location
- **Style:** Italian cafe with pizzas, salads, homemade pastas
- **Book at:** https://www.labriolacafe.com/

### 7. **Gibsons Italia** (West Loop/Near River)
- **Address:** 233 N Canal St, Chicago, IL 60606
- **Style:** Elegant Italian from the legendary Gibsons Restaurant Group, generous portions
- **Note:** Great for special occasions; fills quickly on Fridays

Since today is in 2025 and you're looking for **this Friday night**, here are your best options:

| Method | How to Do It |
|--------|-------------|
| **Online Booking** | Visit the restaurant's website directly or use OpenTable/Resy |
| **Phone Call** | Call the restaurant directly during business hours |
| **Walk-in** | Arrive early (5:00-5:30 PM) and ask for bar seating or the waitlist |

## Tips for Last-Minute Friday Reservations:
- **Call directly** – Restaurants sometimes hold tables or have last-minute cancellations
- **Be flexible with time** – 5:30 PM or 9:00+ PM slots may still be available
- **Consider bar seating** – Many restaurants serve full menus at the bar without reservations
- **Try Eataly Chicago** (43 E Ohio St) – Multiple restaurants under one roof with more availability: https://www.eataly.com/us_en/stores/chicago
